error_reason: In Turn 5, the Planner incorrectly extracted a fixed list of 14 members for Letters to Cleo based on visible viewport text (which only showed the top 12-14% of the page). The Wikipedia page for a band typically includes a full timeline or 'Members' section further down. By treating the partial, fragmented list of names seen in the top viewport as the complete set of distinct members, the agent performed an incorrect verification of the data. This error propagated through Turn 7, leading to a premature and likely inaccurate conclusion without actually verifying the full content of the page.

suggested_fix.fix_text: Before extracting a final list of members, scroll down the page to the 'History' or 'Members' section to ensure all current and past members are captured, as the initial viewport often only shows the top summary.

probe_details.notes: The proposed error analysis is accurate. The agent (Planner) in Turn 5 treated the truncated text visible in the top 12-14% of the Wikipedia page as a complete dataset. Turn 6 reveals the agent navigated away to a different band (Screaming Trees), yet Turn 7 still claims to have verified the full list of 14 members from Letters to Cleo. This confirms the hallucination/verification failure occurred because the agent did not scroll to verify the full 'Members' section, which typically appears further down on Wikipedia pages. The error type 'incorrect_verification' is appropriate.
